boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Detroit Mercy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-stakes McNichols Campus sequence for learning the layout, finding student resources, and fitting in an active campus stop.

cards.title: Start at the McNichols Campus entrance
cards.subtitle: 4001 W. McNichols Rd., Detroit
cards.notes: Use the official map at arrival to orient yourself from the main entrance, then mark the Student Union, Library, Calihan Hall, and residence areas.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a map-based walkthrough of Detroit Mercy’s main undergraduate campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy identifies McNichols as its main undergraduate campus at 4001 W. McNichols Road and provides an official campus map.
cards.source_title: Campus Locations | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Enter McNichols Campus from McNichols Road; use the official campus map for current destinations and parking designations.

cards.title: Make the Student Union your first indoor waypoint
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the Student Union and note Public Safety, Student Life, Campus Ministry, dining, the bookstore, and Fountain Lounge for future errands.
cards.short_summary: A practical hub for services, food, and campus support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union houses Public Safety, Student Life, Campus Ministry, University Services, dining locations, the bookstore, and Fountain Lounge.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Snapshot | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Map-listed building on McNichols Campus; check individual offices and services for availability.

cards.title: Pause at Fountain Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Union, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Build in a short reset at the map-listed Fountain Lounge before continuing your walk; it is a useful landmark for meeting someone in the Union.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Union landmark for a brief campus pause.
cards.evidence_claim: The official McNichols Campus map lists Fountain Lounge in the Student Union.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Map | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Union according to the official campus map.

cards.title: Have a weekend meal at Titan Dining Room
cards.subtitle: Student Union, second floor
cards.notes: Plan a brunch or dinner window around the posted weekend schedule, and use this first meal to learn where the main student dining room is located.
cards.short_summary: The main student dining room serves weekend brunch and dinner during semester hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Dining Room is the main student dining location in the Student Union and posts weekend brunch from noon–2 p.m. and dinner from 5–7 p.m. during semester hours.
cards.source_title: Where to Eat | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Posted semester weekend hours are brunch noon–2 p.m. and dinner 5–7 p.m.; meals require a meal plan, flex dollars, or payment as applicable.

cards.title: Find the Library before you need it
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Walk to the Library, identify the Teaching & Learning Center on the first floor, and save the route for a future study or support-services visit.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed academic stop with the Teaching & Learning Center on its first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The official McNichols Campus map lists the Library and identifies the Teaching & Learning Center on its first floor.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Map | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: The Student Success Center is in Room 319 of the McNichols Campus Library; confirm library access hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk through Sacred Heart Square
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Use Sacred Heart Square as an outdoor landmark between campus buildings; pause to locate adjacent routes before heading toward the athletics and recreation side.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor campus landmark on the official map.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart Square is labeled on the official McNichols Campus map.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Map | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Outdoor, map-listed location on McNichols Campus; use normal campus access and weather judgment.

cards.title: Try a recreation option at Whitty
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Stop by the Whitty Student Fitness Center to learn its layout and choose a comfortable first activity, such as cardio, stretching, or a fitness program.
cards.short_summary: A student fitness facility with courts, weights, cardio, stretching, and recreation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Whitty Student Fitness Center contains basketball/volleyball/badminton courts, weight and cardio areas, and stretching space; Detroit Mercy says its fitness center is free to students and employees.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Snapshot | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Detroit Mercy identifies its fitness center as free to students and employees; bring required university identification and verify facility hours.

cards.title: Locate Calihan Hall for a future home event
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Find Calihan Hall on your campus loop and check the official athletics calendar later for a suitable home event with friends or hallmates.
cards.short_summary: A central athletics building with student-accessible facilities and home events.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy identifies Calihan Hall as part of McNichols Campus athletics facilities and says students with a Detroit Mercy ID may attend home events free of charge.
cards.source_title: Campus Life and Services | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Students with a Detroit Mercy ID may attend home events free; verify the sport, event schedule, and entry requirements before going.

cards.title: Add Titan Field to your campus bearings
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Walk past Titan Field during daylight as part of your map loop, then use it as a recognizable reference point when moving between residence and athletics areas.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic-field landmark on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Titan Field is labeled on the official McNichols Campus map.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Map | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Outdoor, map-listed destination; field access may be scheduled or restricted, so view it from permitted campus paths.

cards.title: Finish with a route through Kassab Mall
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: End the first campus circuit by crossing Kassab Mall and retracing your route to the Student Union, so the weekend walkthrough becomes a repeatable path.
cards.short_summary: A named campus mall that helps connect the walkthrough’s final leg.
cards.evidence_claim: Kassab Mall is labeled on the official McNichols Campus map.
cards.source_title: McNichols Campus Map | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Outdoor, map-listed location on McNichols Campus; follow campus access guidance and use daylight-aware travel planning.
